_doc: ADR 0159: recruit reutiliza la misma generación procedural de canteranos que el mercado (GeneratedPlayers.Youth). Cifras provisionales, sin medir (Regla H).

description.es: Un padre orgulloso empuja a su chaval al frente. El chaval no parece tan convencido.
description.en: A proud father pushes his kid to the front. The kid doesn't look nearly as convinced.
